description: A script for cleaning up download directories in OpenWrt, deleting older versions of tarballs while keeping the latest.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a file or directory entry with methods to parse version info, delete files, and get paths.

methods.name: parseVer_123
methods.description: Parses version string pattern 1.2.3 with optional patch level.

methods.name: parseVer_12
methods.description: Parses version string pattern 1.2 with optional patch.

methods.name: parseVer_ymd_GIT_SHASUM
methods.description: Parses version pattern with date and GIT SHA sum.

methods.name: parseVer_GIT
methods.description: Gets version based on file modification time.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to handle command-line arguments, process directory, and delete old versions.
